decisions.reason: As a specialized but clearly core-adjacent spraying system that remained on the website in 2024, it fits the firm's customization-heavy coatings business and is unlikely to be withdrawn so soon.

The low-pressure injection pump is close to the established offer, had its own product page in both years, and appears to have progressed from testing into marketable use, so retention is the more likely choice.
This product line builds on proven air-motor technology and extends the firm's material-handling range with several models, which makes it a strong candidate to stay in the portfolio.
Although somewhat more niche than the firm's classic pumps and sprayers, the dedicated web presence and fit with digitalized monitoring solutions argue for keeping it on the market.
Because this 2024 launch is very close to the firm's core two-component spraying business, management would typically allow more time for market development rather than dropping it quickly.
